main_body: Red theater seat seen from the front: a tall backrest block (rows 2-9) above a cushion block (rows 10-13), with armrests at the sides
top_band: Light pink band at rows 2-3 across the top of the backrest, only ~2px, with a lighter highlight on the left. It reads as a cap on the backrest, not a seat surface. The seat cushion below shows no clear top surface.
evidence: In the middle column I see a thin pink cap (rows 2-3), then the flat red backrest face (rows 4-9), then a dark gap line (rows 9-10), then a lighter cushion block (rows 10-13). The backrest and the cushion are both vertical faces seen face-on. The seat surface is not seen from above, because the cushion is only a lighter front panel with no foreshortened horizontal band and no front-edge line. This matches the 'front elevation' and 'thin seat' failures in the guide.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark maroon tinted to the red material, which is good. The body uses about 4 red steps, mostly large flat panels (backrest and cushion are each close to a single tone). There is no grain, dots or stitching. Per-tile colour count is low (about 4-6) compared with the stall and well references, which carry tiles, wood grain and speckle. It looks thinner and flatter than the references.
